title: Autologous Conditioned Serum: Functional and Clinical Results
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to investigate the potential ability of autologous conditioned serum (ACS) to decrease the pain and improve the joint functionality in patients affected by knee osteoarthritis (OA).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* knee osteoarthritis \>3 months in clinical and radiographic signs
* VAS for pain \>50mm

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hepatitis B
* Hepatitis C
* HIV
* pregnancy
* drug abuse
* other intra-articular injections \<6 months
* surgery on affected knee \<12 months
